theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (w : NVector (Eucl P) n) (θ : Covector (Eucl P) n), ∑ β : SimonMultiIndex n P, (euclideanNVectorCoordinate w β) ^ 2 = 1 → |w θ| ≤ ∑ β : SimonMultiIndex n P, |euclideanCovectorCoordinate θ β|
